usage: The word 配飯 is used to indicate that a dish is served with rice.
配飯 acts as a noun phrase referring to the rice accompaniment found in many meals.
It is commonly seen on menus to specify that a meal includes a portion of rice, especially in set meals or combos.
In sentences, 配飯 usually follows the name of the dish or appears as part of a description.
When ordering food, you might use 配飯 to ask if a dish comes with rice or to specify you want rice served alongside.
